name: dr_wav
scope: WAV sample rate, channel and frame counts, plus first four decoded PCM samples
family_note: Standalone dr_wav release in dr_libs; miniaudio embeds dr_wav lineage.

name: miniaudio
scope: WAV sample rate, channel and frame counts, plus first four decoded PCM samples
family_note: Distinct miniaudio package and public C decoder API; WAV decoder derives from dr_wav.

name: libsndfile
scope: WAV sample rate, channel and frame counts, plus first four decoded PCM samples
family_note: Own audio file parser and PCM reader.

name: raylib
input_api: LoadWave(local WAV path); Wave.sampleRate, channels, frameCount, data; UnloadWave
scope: WAV sample rate, channel and frame counts, plus first four decoded PCM samples
family_note: Distinct raylib package C loading API; WAV implementation shares dr_wav family.

name: ffmpeg
input_api: avformat_open_input(local WAV path); avformat_find_stream_info; av_read_frame; avcodec_send_packet and avcodec_receive_frame
scope: WAV sample rate, channel and frame counts, plus first four decoded PCM samples
family: FFmpeg WAV demuxer and PCM decoder
family_note: FFmpeg libavformat/libavcodec pair; installed Homebrew build is GPL-enabled.

name: sox
input_api: sox_init; sox_open_read(local WAV path); sox_read decoded samples; sox_sample_t conversion; sox_close
scope: WAV sample rate, channel and frame counts, plus first four decoded PCM samples
family_note: SoX public libsox audio file API reads RIFF/WAVE and decoded samples; pinned source release is the primary SourceForge package.

name: sdl3
input_api: SDL_LoadWAV(local WAV path, SDL_AudioSpec*, Uint8**, Uint32*); SDL_free decoded PCM buffer
scope: WAV sample rate, channel and frame counts, plus first four decoded PCM samples
family_note: SDL3 core WAV-specific loading API; separate package and parser path from SDL_mixer, which remains unresolved.

name: sdl3_mixer
input_api: MIX_Init; MIX_LoadAudio(NULL, local WAV path, true); MIX_GetAudioFormat; MIX_GetAudioDuration; MIX_DestroyAudio
scope: parsed audio sample rate, channel count and duration in frames
family_note: Dedicated src/decoder_wav.c in the pinned release derives from SDL2_mixer music_wav.c and earlier SDL_wave.c; related SDL lineage but separate from SDL3 core LoadWAV implementation.

name: libaudiofile
input_api: afOpenFile(local WAV path, "r"); afGetFileFormat(AF_FILE_WAVE); afSetVirtualSampleFormat; afReadFrames; afGetRate, afGetChannels, afGetFrameCount
scope: WAV sample rate, channel and frame counts, plus first four decoded PCM samples
family_note: Tagged 0.3.6 C API from mpruett/audiofile, unrelated to the Conan audiofile recipe for a C++ header-only package. One build-only signed-shift compatibility patch is documented.

name: aubio
input_api: new_aubio_source(local WAV path, original sample rate, hop size); aubio_source_do; aubio_source_get_samplerate, channels, duration
scope: WAV sample rate, channel and frame counts, plus first four decoded PCM samples
family_note: Distinct C package source API; installed build links Apple AudioToolbox and libsndfile. The exact backend chosen for this control was not isolated, so parser-engine independence is not claimed.

name: csfml
input_api: sfSoundBuffer_createFromFile(local WAV path); sfSoundBuffer_getSamples, getSampleCount, getSampleRate, getChannelCount
scope: WAV sample rate, channel and frame counts, plus first four decoded PCM samples
family: CSFML C facade over SFML audio
family_note: Official C binding around SFML SoundBuffer. The installed CSFML and SFML audio binaries are both SHA-256-checked; this shares SFML parser implementation rather than adding a new engine.

name: allegro
input_api: al_init; al_install_audio; al_init_acodec_addon; al_load_sample(local WAV path); al_get_sample_frequency, channels, length, data
scope: WAV sample rate, channel and frame counts, plus first four decoded PCM samples
family_note: Allegro audio codec add-on registers its own WAV loader; official versioned docs list little-endian PCM WAV support. Core, audio and codec add-on binaries are SHA-256-checked.
